g.text: Every transition is a document write (ui/track.js)
Guards: Start only when status === 'idle' and a client is picked ('Add a client first.').
Save needs ≥ 1 tracked second, else toast 'Nothing tracked yet.'
Stays local: never synced, only the saved entry is.
⏸ when paused · ■ when stopped · the original
date is the LOCAL day the session
UTC stays on the right day).
